step2_setup_google_cloud.description: Create Google Cloud project and enable Indexing API
actions: Create a new project or select existing
Enable 'Indexing API' in APIs & Services > Library
Generate JSON key and save as 'service_account_key.json'
Copy the client_email from the JSON file

step4_add_to_search_console.description: Grant service account access to Search Console
actions: Go to Settings > Users and permissions
Add user with the service account email

important_notes: The script will automatically find all HTML pages on your website
Google allows 200 URL submissions per day via the API
After submission, check Google Search Console for indexing status
Fix any 404 errors before submitting URLs
Remove 'noindex' meta tags from pages you want indexed

troubleshooting.permission_denied: Ensure service account has Owner permission in Search Console
troubleshooting.api_not_enabled: Enable Indexing API in Google Cloud Console
troubleshooting.urls_not_indexing: Check for noindex tags, improve content quality, build internal links
